package.name: marine_world_store
package.description: World store (rev 3) library and CLIs: store-root resolution, the quantity/state/origin directory layout, content-based source identity, product fingerprints, STAC Items/Collections and append-only revision records. Deliberately a plain Python package -- nothing here imports rclpy or ament, so the same code runs under `pip install .` off a ROS host; this package.xml is a shim so rosdep resolves its dependencies and colcon installs it into the ROS install space (rolker/unh_marine_autonomy#397, design in docs/world_store_design.md).
